checked_from: Claude Code cloud container behind the agent HTTPS proxy

route_meanings.api: `studio assets search` and `studio assets fetch --source <id>` work end to end
route_meanings.direct: a stable file URL found on the asset page; fetch it with `studio assets fetch --source <id> --url <file>`
route_meanings.recipe: a few scripted steps (see sources.md) produce a temporary file URL; fetch that with `--source <id> --url <file>`
route_meanings.login: downloads need a signed-in account or API token; a person downloads, the agent records it with `studio assets add`
route_meanings.blocked: the site refuses scripted clients; a person downloads, the agent records it with `studio assets add`

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.style_fit: photoreal scans; good base colour, normal and roughness sources to repaint or simplify
sources.notes: Use the API, never scrape: the site terms forbid scraping. API calls must send a User-Agent naming the tool (the helper does). Downloaded assets need no credit; only software that shows live API results to users must name Poly Haven. Files come with md5, which the helper checks.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.style_fit: large PBR material set with consistent file names; strong for tiling walls, roofs, ground
sources.notes: One-person site; the owner asks heavy users to stay modest. Fetch the size you need (1K or 2K JPG for most game work), not every variant.

sources.name: Share Textures
sources.style_fit: architectural surfaces, wood, fabric, metal up to 4K
sources.notes: Each asset page embeds `downloadLinks` JSON with stable https://files.sharetextures.com/file/Share-Textures/<name>-<1K|2K|4K>.zip URLs.

sources.name: cgbookcase
sources.style_fit: PBR sets with full map channels
sources.notes: Zips live at https://cgbookcase-volume.b-cdn.net/t/<Name>_<1K|2K|4K>.zip (Name is the CamelCase id from the page's download link). The CDN answers 403 without `--referer https://www.cgbookcase.com/`.

sources.name: TextureCan
sources.style_fit: 650+ PBR textures, bricks, tiles, wood, ground
sources.notes: The site answers 406 to clients that send a bare User-Agent; a browser-like User-Agent and Accept header work (the helper sends both). Detail pages link /downloads/<id>/<id>_<1k|2k|4k>_<token>.zip.

sources.name: The Base Mesh
sources.style_fit: 900+ clean-topology starting shapes (props, architecture pieces, anatomy) meant to be reshaped
sources.notes: The /model-library page lists every model; each links https://www.thebasemesh.com/_files/archives/<hash>.zip?dn=<name>.zip.

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.style_fit: low-poly stylized modular kits (medieval village, town, nature), often rigged
sources.notes: Free downloads are served through the pack's itch.io page (quaternius.itch.io/<pack>); use the itch.io recipe. Paid tiers (Pro, Source) are not free assets.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.style_fit: clean low-poly kits (city, castle, nature) in GLB/FBX/OBJ; great for blockout and props
sources.notes: Each asset page links a versioned zip under https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/<slug>/<hash>/kenney_<slug>_<version>.zip.

sources.name: Poly Pizza
sources.style_fit: thousands of low-poly models, many from the Google Poly archive
sources.notes: Cloudflare challenge (403) on the site and its API needs a key (401). Mixed CC0 and CC-BY 3.0: record the author for every CC-BY model.

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.style_fit: uneven quality; occasional good low-poly packs
sources.notes: Each page shows its licences; the files live at https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/<file>. Pages often list several licences: pick CC0 or CC-BY. CC-BY-SA, GPL and OGA-BY are refused by the helper.

sources.name: itch.io free 3D assets
sources.style_fit: community kits incl. retro/PSX and stylized packs
sources.notes: Licence is whatever the pack page states; many say CC0, some only 'free to use' (unclear, skip). The download URL is signed and expires, so the original file must be kept; it cannot be re-fetched later.

sources.name: Blend Swap
sources.notes: Browsing works but downloads need a signed-in account. Many blends are CC-BY-SA or CC-BY-NC: only CC0 and CC-BY pass.

sources.name: Sketchfab (CC filter)
sources.notes: Search API works without a key (https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/search?type=models&downloadable=true&license=cc0); the download endpoint needs the person's API token (401 without).
